set -eu

mkdir -p /root/.ssh
chmod 700 /root/.ssh

  ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C 'host-certificate-local-verification' -f /root/.ssh/host-cert-test

  cat /root/.ssh/host-cert-test.pub >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
